context: A Kansai friend rants about a TV personality with his girlfriend
purpose: Teach: 人格/一見/ツッコミ/あぁ/何処/とかいう/しょうが/未だに

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: あぁ、もうあのタレント、未だにテレビ出てんのが信じられへんわ。
lines.en: Ugh, I still can't believe that TV personality is on the air.
lines.style: Frustrated Kansai groan venting to his close girlfriend

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 誰のこと?一見いい人そうに見えるけど、人格に問題あるって噂のあの人?
lines.en: Who? The one rumored to have personality issues despite seeming nice?
lines.style: Gentle curious tone soothing her boyfriend's grumpy mood

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: せやねん、現場でスタッフにめっちゃ当たり散らすらしいで、しょうがない奴やわ。
lines.en: Yeah, apparently he really lays into the staff on set, hopeless guy.
lines.style: Kansai dialect ranting with exasperated emphasis throughout the line

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ひどい…でも何処の局も使い続けてるのが不思議だよね。
lines.en: Awful. Yet it's strange every network keeps hiring him.
lines.style: Soft sympathetic murmur expressing quiet disbelief alongside him

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ほんまや、誰かガツンとツッコミ入れたれよって思うわ。
lines.en: Right? I wish someone would just give him a sharp comeback.
lines.style: Animated Kansai delivery with playful frustration rising naturally

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 業界の暗黙のルールとかいう奴のせいかな、誰も逆らえないみたい。
lines.en: Maybe industry's unspoken rules stop anyone from pushing back.
lines.style: Thoughtful murmured speculation winding down the rant slowly

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: あほくさ、もうチャンネル替えよ。おれはお前といる方がよっぽど幸せやわ。
lines.en: Ridiculous. Let's change channels. I'm way happier just with you.
lines.style: Warm Kansai pivot from grumbling to affectionate teasing softly
